output.content: I am checking the validation logs for the new model release. The acceptance criteria are currently done by hand. I see a spreadsheet where the test results are typed in manually after each run. There is no automated check in the pipeline. The process involves copying values from the terminal into the sheet. I observe that the timestamps on the sheet entries do not match the system logs exactly. The workflow requires a person to verify each row before the model is approved for deployment.
output.reclassify_reason: The text consists entirely of observational statements describing the current manual validation process and discrepancies, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
